text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The new year arrived. Buena Vista moved up 
to the Classic Class—and was finally set 
to challenge the Triple Tiara route.
choice_data_list: (Gotta get fired up and give it my all!)
(We've got to get fired up for this!)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: “—Trainer? Trainer!”

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: The sukiyaki's ready! Let's dig in!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I spent a relaxing New Year's after being 
invited to Buena Vista's family home. 
Right now, I'm being treated to sukiyaki.

text_block_list.name: Buena's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep adding more, okay? If you space 
out, Buena's gonna eat it all up.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Geez~. I'm not *that* big of a 
glutton! ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Phew~... That was delicious.

text_block_list.name: Buena's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Seeing you two relaxing side by 
side like that brings back old memories.

text_block_list.name: Buena's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I thought it might be tough this year... 
but I'm so glad you could make it, <username>.
choice_data_list:
Thank you for the meal, I really 
appreciate it.

text_block_list.name: Buena's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I thought it might be tough this year... 
but I'm so glad you could make it, <username>.
choice_data_list:
Thank you for the meal, I really 
appreciate it.

text_block_list.name: Buena's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Not at all, feel free to take it easy 
today. Things have been tough lately, 
haven't they?

text_block_list.name: Buena's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Buena tells me over the phone, you know. 
Things like, 'My Trainer seems really 
busy,' or 'What should I make for a 
late-night snack?'..."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: M-Mom.
choice_data_list: Buena... thank you for worrying about me.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...No. I'm not worried at all, you know?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Because I believe in you. ...You 
understand, don't you?"

text_block_list.name: Buena's Mother
text_block_list.text: ...You two really are great friends.

text_block_list.name: Buena's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right... It looks like the nearby 
elementary school is opening its gym for 
New Year's calligraphy. Why not go check 
it out?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we arrived at a nearby elementary 
school. Buena Vista had brought along the 
calligraphy set she used to use, but...
choice_data_list: Is that... could that be mine...?
Is that... could that be mine...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It's a hand-me-down from elementary 
school.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
The brush was still in good shape and 
looked usable, so I brought it along.
choice_data_list: You were still saving it for me?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I took really good care of it. 
Look, even the name sticker is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the calligraphy set, I saw 
"Buena Vista" written right next to the 
sticker with my own name on it.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
It feels kind of like a waste to overwrite 
it, you know?
choice_data_list: Thank you for taking good care of it.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Fufu, yeah! Alright, let's write it down.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The start of Buena Vista's all-important 
Classic Year. What should our aspirations 
be—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want her to build plenty of stamina to 
withstand high-intensity training. With 
that in mind, I poured my heart into 
writing 'Physical Conditioning.'

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, that's...! —It's the exact same as 
mine...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You'll be doing a lot more training from 
here on, right? That's why I thought you 
ought to build up your stamina.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Fufu... What an amazing coincidence!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At any rate, health comes first. Wishing 
for Buena Vista to stay healthy forever, I 
poured my heart into writing 'Health 
First.'

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, that's...! —It's the exact same as 
mine...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Racing is tough, so I thought I should 
put my health first."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Fufu... What an amazing coincidence!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista's overall abilities are 
already at a high level. To give her an 
unexpected edge, I wrote down 
'Multi-talented.'

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, that's...! —It's the exact same as 
mine...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Since I have the chance, I thought I'd 
write down something interesting.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Fufu... What an amazing coincidence!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Once we get back to the academy, let's 
hang them up side by side in the Trainer's 
room!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, we relaxed a bit longer at 
Buena Vista's family home... and on our 
way back to the academy—

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? B-Buena-chan!? Whoa, the real 
deal...! ...A-A Happy New Year to you!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year! Um, what are you all...

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
Wawa, we're huge fans of yours, 
Buena-chan...! Oh, r-right! 
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh? Congratulations for...?

text_block_list.name: Student C
text_block_list.text:
Ah! There's a super famous voting site 
among race fans... "The 1st"... look, this 
is it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What I was shown was the most prestigious 
poll site among race fans. For each race, 
fans vote on which girl they want to cheer 
for.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Who carries the greatest expectations"... 
On this site, which visualizes that with 
considerable accuracy, Buena Vista is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was tipped as the top favorite for the 
Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
We voted for Buena-chan too! All of us are 
so excited for it...!

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
I believe that if it's Buena-chan, she 
could even become the 3rd Triple Tiara 
umamusume in history...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume who wins the Oka Sho, Yushun 
Himba (Japanese Oaks), and Shuka Sho is 
hailed as a Triple Tiara Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the long history of the Twinkle Series, 
only two have ever accomplished that—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu and Still in Love. Apart 
from these two great Umamusume, no one 
else holds that prestigious title.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "The Triple Tiara... I will...!!"

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
If it's Buena-chan, she can totally do 
it~!

text_block_list.name: Student C
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, if it's Buena-chan... I'd 
really love to see you go for the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe...!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe too...!

text_block_list.name: Student C
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but if I run in the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe, I won't be able to run in the 
Shuka Sho since they're around the same 
time...

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
Huh, no way, no way! I totally want to see 
Buena-chan win the Triple Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Student C
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I want to see it too!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Everyone has studied the races so 
thoroughly, haven't they?

text_block_list.name: Student C
text_block_list.text:
Ah! S-Sorry... We're just placing all our 
selfish expectations on you...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"No, I'm happy to hear it! In fact, please 
tell me more!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
The more expectations people place on me, 
the heavier the weight I carry... and the 
bigger my dreams grow. And that's... a 
truly wonderful thing!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Right? The Triple Tiara, apparently.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Do you think I can do it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista's dream—the magnificent vista 
she aims for—is one that 'reaches 
everyone.' If expectations are placed upon 
her, she naturally wants to live up to 
them.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"My breathtaking view might just be right 
there."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"The Triple Tiara... I bet that view will 
make my heart tremble, just like the 
breathtaking sight Spe-san showed me."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Well? Do you think you can reach it?
choice_data_list:
Either way, you have no intention of 
losing, right?

Either way, you have no intention of 
losing, right?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Of course. ...Your mind was already made 
up, wasn't it?"
choice_data_list: Let's aim for it. The Triple Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "...Yeah. I'll do my best."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(Once I get back to the dorm, I need to 
commit the training menu to memory—)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Eek!?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for bumping into you...! Are you 
all right?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Wait... Desire-chan!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(Red Desire-chan. My wonderful classmate 
with such a unique charm. And—)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry, are you okay? That had to 
hurt, right...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm fine. If anything, I should 
apologize for spacing out.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...By the way, Buena. Did something good 
happen today? Your aura... it's 
glittering.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Good things... yeah, so many good things 
happened! Ehehe, was it that obvious?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Your radiance is so immense... 
It's as if you're the sun of this world.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to seeing you on the turf. 
During those dazzling days when the three 
jewels sparkle—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: The three jewels, you say...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ah! —The Triple Tiara!
